name: Ecliptic
description: The apparent path of the sun, drawn as a band tilted off the equator with the disc riding it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -12%; top: 40%; width: 124%; height: 20%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(-23deg, 23deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(-23deg, 23deg)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: @pick(12%, 44%, 66%); top: 34%; width: 30%; height: 30%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
